question: Which of the following Articles of the Constitution of India guarantees equality of opportunity in matters of public employment?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Article 16__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Article 16 - Equality of opportunity in matters of employment.
 
• The fundamental rights are enshrined in part III of the constitution from Articles 12 to 35.
 
• Part III is described as the Magna Carta of India.
 
• The fundamental rights are guaranteed by the constitution to all persons without any discrimination. 
 
• Features of fundamental rights - 
 
 
• They are justiciable as they are legally enforceable.
 
• They have legal sanctions.
 
• They are automatically enforced. They do not require any legislation for their implementation.
 
• They aim to establish political democracy.
 
• They are negative as they prohibit the state from doing certain things.
 
• They are not absolute but qualified.
 
• They are not permanent.
 
 
 
• The fundamental rights have been taken from the USA i.e., the Bill of Rights.
 
• Originally, the Constitution provided for seven fundamental rights 
 
 
• Right to equality (Articles 14 to 18)
 
• Right to freedom (Articles 19 to 22)
 
• Right against exploitation (Articles 23 to 24)
 
• Right to freedom of religion (Articles 25 to 28)
 
• Cultural and educational rights (Articles 29 to 30)
 
• Right to property (Article 31)
 
• Right to constitutional remedies (Article 32)
 
 
 
• Right to property was deleted by the 44th **Constitutional Amendment Act** of 1978.
 
 
• It is made a legal right under Article 300-A in part XII of the constitution.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Some of the fundamental rights are available only to citizens while others are available to all persons.
 
• Fundamental rights available only to citizens and not to foreigners - 
 
 
• Article 15 - Prohibition of discrimination on grounds of religion, race, caste, sex or place of birth.
 
• **Article 16 - Equality of opportunity in matters of employment.**
 
• Article 19 - Protection of six rights regarding freedom.
 
• Article 29 - Protection of language, script, and culture of minorities.
 
• Article 30 - Right of minorities to establish and administer educational institutions.
 
 
 
• Fundamental rights to both citizens and foreigners (except enemy aliens)
 
 
• Article 14 - Equality of laws and equal protection of laws.
 
• Article 20 - Protection in respect of conviction for offences.
 
• Article 21 - Protection of life and personal liberty.
 
• Article 21A - Right to elementary education.
 
• Article 22 - Protection against arrest and detention in certain cases.
 
• Article 23 - Protection of traffic in human beings and forced labour.
 
• Article 24 - Protection of employment of children in factories.
 
• Article 25 - freedom of conscience and free profession, practice and propagation of religion.
 
• Article 26 - Freedom to manage religious affairs.
 
• Article 27 - Freedom from payment of taxes for promotion of any religion.
 
• Article 28 - Freedom from attending religious instructions or worship in certain educational institutions.
